listing.name: Need for Speed: Most Wanted (2005, Xbox 360) / SpeedBreaker
listing.summary: Unofficial static recompilation of the Xbox 360 version of Need for Speed: Most Wanted (2005): a native port for Steam Deck, Steam Machine, Steam Frame, Linux and Mac (iPhone/iPad: sideload the experimental IPA or build it yourself). Bring your own disc: no game files included. Not affiliated with EA or Valve.
